text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Tunisian woman found in possession of heroin after being searched following a flight from Turkey. Police described the haul as "substantial", adding that the 28-year-old woman had travelled to Malta several times before.
- Commerce minister promises frank talks with Chamber of Commerce on removal of Value Added Tax.

- Call for tenders for new San Raffaele hospital's medical equipment, valued at around $30 million, postponed for about one year. The new Labour government has said it is assessing whether to continue building the hospital on which construction is already underway.

- Cooperation with the United States on arms trafficking: Foreign Minister George Vella addresses seminar of Maltese and U.S. officials on how possible arms trafficking could be detected and prevented.
